title: Plugin Port v1
description: Plugin Subsystem v1 Port data contract (CON §3 FROZEN). Unknown fields are refused by construction (additionalProperties: false at every level). The schema enforces SHAPE only (types, enums, required keys); the policy gates that demand semantically-rich refusal codes (kebab port_id, JSON-serializability negative tests, three-role seam) live in daemon/plugin_subsystem/port_registry.py and daemon/plugin_subsystem/capability_seam_gate.py and deliberately carry no structural constraint here, so the dedicated code always wins over a generic structural code.

port_id.description: dotted-kebab stable identifier (e.g. 'od.generate'); semantic code port_id_invalid enforces the dotted-kebab shape in daemon/plugin_subsystem/port_registry.py

version.description: Port-level version; bumped per-Port, never per manifest schema

inputs_schema.description: JSON-Schema for Port inputs; ALL fields must be JSON-serializable. The semantic gate (daemon/plugin_subsystem/port_registry.py:validate_port_serializability) refuses non-serializable shapes (raw object, callable, datetime-without-format, binary-without-contentEncoding).

outputs_schema.description: JSON-Schema for Port outputs; same serializability rules as inputs_schema.

envelope.description: CON §3 typed error envelope. MANDATORY at every Port. The ok key is a JSON-Schema const false (errors always report ok=false); code and message are mandatory; details is optional.

ok.description: CON §3 mandates ok is a const false (the error envelope always reports ok=false). Any other shape is refused by the gate.

code.description: Machine-readable error code (one of the per-Port enumerated codes declared in the Port's outputs_schema; some conventions restrict codes further per Port — see opendesign.ports.py for the canonical codeset)

capability_tags.description: Catalog-only tags (CON §3: not for routing). Examples: ['generation', 'design'], ['persistence'].

provider.description: Provider role = OUR wrapper (CON §3; the plugin is a resource, never a Provider)

path.description: Path-type letter per plugins-convention/path_types.yaml. A is fenced (engine-only exception); C is resource-only; B is lifted-symbol.

consumer.description: NAMED consumers only (CON §3); anonymous '["*"]' is refused at the semantic gate.
